=='''Overview'''==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He is only obtainable via evolving [[Hubris (Night)]].

{{EvolutionTable}}
He can be evolved into [[Hubris (The One)]] by having 1,000,000 Sunshine, something he can get by either upon taking down enemies (the later the story/infinite level, the more Sunshine you get), taking down Sunshine Demons on Fabled Kingdom Infinite (or in Portals), or by clearing Fabled Kingdom portals and using [[Evolution|Sunshine Essence]] on him.
* Note that each Sunshine Essence will give 25,000 Sunshine on the unit.
